concerns.text: Assumption states “filter for prompts that have ≥ 3 human‑annotated high‑quality rationales”, while FR‑001, FR‑002, FR‑012 and the Edge Cases require **≥ 4** rationales. This direct contradiction creates ambiguity about the required filter threshold.

Functional requirements reference user‑story IDs “US‑1”, “US‑2”, and “US‑3”, but the specification only names them as “User Story 1”, “User Story 2”, and “User Story 3”. The IDs US‑1/US‑2/US‑3 do not exist, leading to unstable terminology and unresolved cross‑references.
